description: Confirms that --clip / --audio-clip rebuild the corresponding track and warns before destructive edits.
expectations: node create timeline accepts --clip and / or --audio-clip
node edit timeline with --clip or --audio-clip rebuilds the corresponding track and re-issues clip identities
Clip references are bare node ids or lowercase resource UUIDs; node: / res: prefix returns cli.invalid_resource_reference
Audio-only timeline is valid; server inserts an empty visual track
Track replacement requires explicit user consent
Paid execution is handed off to dreamina-canvas-quote-and-run
